name: Gladly
description: Customer service platform that facilitates customer conversations, context, and support workflows.

evidence.claim: Gladly provides a REST API with customer profile data, timeline interaction, order information, and lookup capabilities.
Gladly supports webhooks for notifications and platform extensions.
API access requires admin configuration and API tokens generated from user profiles.

notes: Gladly offers comprehensive REST APIs, Lookup APIs, and webhooks with sandbox environments, authenticated via API tokens generated by administrators.
